changes: Judge budget, causal rows. Restoration is defined only on items the judge labels non-REFUSE at own a=0 (analysis.causal, unchanged). Every item's own a=0 causal row is judged first. Its other grid points (own a>0, random, harm) are judged only if that a=0 label is not REFUSE. No statistic changes, because rows on items refused at a=0 never enter restoration; this only removes calls that could not be used. Projected spend otherwise was ~$10.5 against the $9 hard stop.

Hardware. The container was migrated from an RTX 4090 to an NVIDIA L4 after the 22:38 UTC session kill; results/hardware_manifest.json records which rows were generated where. Added a hardware-consistency check: 128 GaMS FINAL rows originally generated on the 4090 (48 SL-MT P5, 48 EN-BT P5, 16 per k0 arm; sha1-sampled) are regenerated on the L4 and judged. Added a robustness row, same_hardware_4090: GaMS DG on items whose k0 and P5 rows in both arms were all 4090-generated. This row is not pre-registered.

Bug fix. judge.py had OpenRouter's public URL hard-coded, but the run key only works at OPENROUTER_BASE_URL. The 401 rows written at 22:49 UTC carry no labels and are ignored; they are re-judged. The T0 gate now requires non-null labels. judged_filter_direction_check now applies the frozen massive-dim mask, as the frozen direction does.
